summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Advanced Volunteer Query Engine feature. All 22 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend UI tests pass - Query Engine tab loads correctly with filters, presets, results table, and bulk assignment functionality. Past winners images on homepage display correctly. JGF Card Holders placeholder on tickets page is present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Query Engine feature fully tested. All APIs working: /api/marshal/volunteers/query, /api/marshal/bulk-assign, /api/marshal/assignment-locations, /api/marshal/assignment-supervisors, /api/marshal/query-presets. Frontend Query Engine tab in Marshal Dashboard works with filters, presets, results table, bulk selection, and export.

query_engine_tab.details: Query Engine tab loads in Marshal Dashboard with filters panel, quick presets, and results panel

query_filters.details: All filters work: role (scorer/marshal), status (approved/pending/rejected), days (Thu/Fri/Sat/Sun), time slots (AM/PM/All Day), Karen membership, nationality (Kenyan/Non-Kenyan), experience, unassigned only

karen_membership_normalization.details: Karen membership filter correctly matches variations: Karen, Karen Country Club, KCC, etc.

run_query_button.details: Run Query button executes search and displays results with statistics

bulk_selection.details: Checkboxes allow selecting multiple volunteers for bulk operations

assignment_modal.details: Assignment modal works with locations and supervisors dropdowns

quick_presets.details: Quick presets load and apply filters correctly. Default presets: All Scorers - Thursday AM, Karen Members Only, Unassigned Approved Volunteers, Experienced Marshals, Weekend Coverage - Scorers

export_csv.details: Export query results to CSV works with proper formatting and summary statistics

api_query_endpoint.details: POST /api/marshal/volunteers/query returns volunteers, total, filters_applied, statistics

api_bulk_assign_endpoint.details: POST /api/marshal/bulk-assign assigns location, supervisor, shifts, notes to selected volunteers

api_locations_endpoint.details: GET /api/marshal/assignment-locations returns 29 predefined locations (Hole 1-18, Clubhouse, etc.)

api_supervisors_endpoint.details: GET /api/marshal/assignment-supervisors returns list of supervisors from marshal_users

api_presets_endpoints.details: GET/POST /api/marshal/query-presets for loading and saving query presets

past_winners_images.details: All 6 past winners images display correctly on homepage: Jacques Kruyswijk (2025), Darius van Driel (2024), Jorge Campillo (2023), Wu Ashun (2022), Justin Harding (2021), Guido Migliozzi (2019)

jgf_card_holders_placeholder.details: JGF Card Holders section on tickets page displays FREE ENTRY badge, title, description, and features

tickets_page_layout.details: Tickets page has narrower horizontal layout with max-w-5xl constraint

api_endpoints_tested.description: Advanced volunteer query with combinable filters
